page.overview:
Who is Adrielle?

She is tall and beautiful., Adrielle|Adrielle}} She is taller than Mezar Kurin, the Asha'man she is bonded to..

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

She was one of fifty-one sisters sent to destroy the Black Tower. They were, however, all captured and bonded by the Asha'man. Adrielle is bonded to Mezar Kurin. She has become quite friendly with Kurin even though she was bonded against her will.

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Toveine, at Alviarin's suggestion .
